name: Cache Lack Probability and Measure
desc: Measure-theoretic probability lecture series from Cache Lack Math & Stats Lectures covering measures and sigma-algebras, Caratheodory extension, Lebesgue measure, measurable functions, integration and convergence theorems, Lebesgue-Stieltjes and product measures with Fubini-Tonelli, Lp spaces and inequalities, convergence of measures, the strong law of large numbers, the central limit theorem, and the ergodic theorem.
